summary: advance_back_to could set key_back below key when the requested back bound precedes the front word. The fix preserves key_back == key, clears both cached words, and returns immediately. The verbatim reversal is uniquely matched, but no detecting upstream test was established at this revision. The added test combine_with_nth in roaring/tests/iter_advance_to.rs exercises this branch, yet source inspection shows next_back returns None with either implementation. Contrary to the imported candidate description, this revision contains no bitmap iterator debug assertion checking the violated invariant. Leave detection blocked; no tests were executed.
